bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 9045) cites Muhammad ibn Sallam al-Jumahi and Ibn Qani' via his descendant Abd al-Qahir ibn al-Sari ibn Qays ibn al-Haytham. It says the Prophet appointed al-Haytham to collect the sadaqa of his people and that he delivered it to Abu Bakr, who praised him together with al-Zibriqan; it gives him the nisba al-Sulami.
research_evidence: ٩٠٤٥- الهيثم، والد قيس. ذكره محمّد بن سلّام الجمحيّ، وابن قانع مختصرا، من طريق عبد القاهر بن السّري بن قيس بن الهيثم
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)
